name: 线性图案检测
description: Detects unnatural linear patterns in 图像
algorithm: Linear Pattern Detection — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method detects linear patterns for image forensic analysis using features inspired by Fridrich & Kodovsky (2012):

1. **LinearStructure检测**: The image is analyzed for linear structures using directional filtering (oriented Gabor filters, Hough transform, or Radon transform). Lines, edges, and linear patterns are extracted with their orientation, length, and intensity.

2. **Linear模式Regularity分析**: The regularity and periodicity of linear patterns are analyzed. Natural images contain some linear structures (architecture, horizon lines) but AI-generated images may show: (a) excessive linear regularity, (b) line patterns from the generator's convolutional grid structure, (c) artificial straight lines where natural curves should exist.

3. **方向直方图**: The distribution of linear pattern orientations is computed. Natural scenes show orientation distributions related to scene geometry (many horizontal/vertical lines in architectural scenes, random orientations in natural scenes). AI generators may produce orientation biases from their training data or architecture.

4. **SubpixelLine分析**: Lines in authentic images, when analyzed at subpixel precision, show characteristics of the optical imaging process: anti-aliasing from the lens, CFA interpolation effects, edge softening. AI-generated lines may show different subpixel profiles — too sharp, too smooth, or with incorrect anti-aliasing patterns.

5. **Linear相干性评分**: The overall coherence of linear patterns is scored. Anomalies include: linear patterns that don't follow perspective geometry, line segments that terminate abruptly without physical justification, and linear structures with non-physical optical characteristics. The score quantifies deviation from expected linear pattern statistics.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： linear pattern detection 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-generated images are surprisingly easy to spot. CVPR.
